title: Reversing the invoice unlocks the field and the next invoice re-captures
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A and sales rep B.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Create a work order for this test for that customer with one "Sales Representative" field set to sales rep A, and invoice it (do not take a payment).
  • Open the work order in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Reverse the invoice of the work order.
  2. Click the Sales Representative field.
  3. Click sales rep B in the dropdown.
  4. Invoice the work order again.
  5. Open Reports > Sales By Representative.
  6. Set the date range to today.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The invoice is reversed.
  • The Sales Representative field can be changed again.

Step 2:

  • The dropdown opens.

Step 3:

  • The field reads sales rep B.

Step 4:

  • The new invoice is created.
  • The field is plain text again, reading sales rep B.

Step 5:

  • The Sales By Representative report opens.

Step 6:

  • The new invoice of the work order is credited to sales rep B, not sales rep A.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative), story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • S2-E4: “Changing a representative after the work order is invoiced or paid is not offered. A change sent by any other route is refused with "The sales representative cannot be changed on an invoiced or paid work order." The invoice keeps the names captured when it was created (Story 5). Reversing the invoice unlocks the field again, and the next invoice captures the names afresh.”
  • S5-R1: “When a work order is invoiced, the parts representative and the labor representative in effect are both captured on the invoice, by name.”
